did: Opened an order in the back office and marked a line Not available. With the PharmaTrack connection on, the medicine is also sent to PharmaTrack's short list.

checks.text: Staff can mark a medicine "Not available" while checking an order, and the order total drops by that line
The medicine is sent once to PharmaTrack's short list (when the link is on and Live), never twice, and never stops the check if PharmaTrack is down (item 612)
The record of medicines asked for but not available is also kept on the Price requests and Reports pages

notes: The short list is PharmaTrack's own list; this site adds to it and does not read it back.
